{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: Uncaged; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its country-rock sound fits some of my listening, but I would pass this time.

ItemID: NA; Title: Roy Orbison - 16 Biggest Hits; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: His soulful vocals appeal to me, but I am not choosing a greatest-hits collection today.

ItemID: NA; Title: Best Of Gary Lewis & The Playboys; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This pop-oriented collection does not fit my current blues-rock mood.
ItemID: NA; Title: Good Times!; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone gives me too little reason to try it during this visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Ultimate Waylon Jennings; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: I occasionally enjoy country, but I am more drawn to the blues selections today.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Lovin' Spoonful - Greatest Hits; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Their rootsy pop has some appeal, but this is not a strong enough match to choose now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Mono; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Without an artist or description, I cannot tell whether this matches what I want.
